title: Pixel Air Strike
description: Blast retro pixel squadrons out of crisp arcade skies—crisp chiptune energy, snappy controls, and endless high-score dogfights.
controls: Drag to steer your pixel fighter, dodge enemy shots, and pick up firepower stars.

zh-CN.title: 像素飞机大战
zh-CN.description: 复古街机像素飞机大战：纯粹硬核的像素风空战体验，丝滑操控狂射敌机刷新个人最高分！
zh-CN.controls: 按住拖动像素战机躲避敌机与子弹，不断射击敌军编队刷新高分。
